fields.label: Approved Target DocType
fields.description: Explicit site allowlist entry. Core manufacturing, stock, accounting, payroll, permission, and system records remain hard-denied.

fields.label: Permitted Generic Actions
fields.description: This policy never bypasses the target DocType controller, workflow, role permissions, or the engine hard-deny list.

fields.label: Allow Submit When Authorized
fields.description: Available only when the approved target DocType is submittable. Runtime posting still requires explicit authorization.

fields.label: Allow Currency Field Mapping
fields.description: Explicitly permit profile mappings to writable Currency fields on this operational target.

fields.label: Allow Non-blocking Failure
fields.description: Permit a profile to use Exception Logged instead of Blocking. Use only where the target record is not required to satisfy task completion.

fields.label: Approval Notes
fields.description: Record the operational purpose and approval basis for this allowlist entry.
